market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$78,200 May 2. Yearly low was ~$60k (per 31% rally claim). $45k requires a further ~42% decline within 8 months without recovery — historically rare absent major macro shock. Already cleared the Nov 2025-now window without hitting $45k.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of severe macro/credit shock triggering crypto liquidations in 2H 2026.
